title: QUEST: A Query and Extraction System for Topics in Asylum Law Application Decisions
abstract: arXiv:2608.28555v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Legal decisions on asylum applications consist of long, complex, and heterogeneous documents, covering narrative applicant interviews, original decisions, and additional supporting materials. If an application is rejected, a critical question in processing an appeal is whether the credibility of the information in the original application was a factor that determined the original decision. In this paper, we present the QUEST system (Query and Extraction System for Topics) to extract and identify factors relating to credibility assessments in two datasets of Danish asylum application appeals. QUEST frames this problem as an information retrieval task, combining synthetic query generation, topic extraction, and relevance assessment to identify information related to credibility indicators in appeals board application materials. translated_title: QUEST：一个用于庇护法申请裁决中主题的查询与提取系统
translated_abstract: 关于庇护申请的法律裁决由冗长、复杂且异构的文档组成，涵盖叙述性的申请人面谈记录、原始裁决以及其他辅助材料。如果申请被驳回，处理上诉时的一个关键问题是：原始申请中信息的可信度是否是导致原始裁决的决定性因素。本文提出了QUEST系统（主题查询与提取系统），用于在两个丹麦庇护申请上诉数据集中提取和识别与可信度评估相关的因素。QUEST将该问题构建为一个信息检索任务，结合合成查询生成、主题提取和相关性评估，以识别上诉委员会申请材料中与可信度指标相关的信息。除了标准的检索评估指标外，我们还提出了一种新型的领域特定评估方法……
tldr: 本文提出了QUEST系统，将丹麦庇护上诉裁决中可信度评估因素的识别问题构建为信息检索任务，通过结合合成查询生成、主题提取与相关性评估来定位上诉材料中的可信度指标，并提出了新的领域特定评估方法。
en_tdlr: The paper presents QUEST, a system that frames the identification of credibility assessment factors in Danish asylum appeal decisions as an information retrieval task, combining synthetic query generation, topic extraction, and relevance assessment, while proposing a new type of domain-specific evaluation.
